review_candidates.title: JavaScript Backend Trainer
review_candidates.description: 🚀 We’re Hiring | Backend JavaScript Instructor AMIT Learning is looking for a passionate and experienced Backend JavaScript Instructor to join our training team. 📍 Location: Egypt 💼 Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time 🏢 Work Model: On-Site 🎓 Company: AMIT Learning 🔹 Responsibilities:Deliver high-quality technical training sessions in Backend JavaScript. Explain backend concepts clearly through practical examples and hands-on projects. Design and deliver structured training materials, exercises, and projects. Mentor trainees and provide technical guidance throughout the training. Stay updated with current backend technologies and industry best practices. 🔹 Technical Requirements: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with: JavaScript & Backend: JavaScript (ES6+) Node.js Express.js NestJS RESTful APIs API Development & Integration Authentication & Authorization JWT Middleware Error Handling WebSockets / Real-Time Applications Databases: MongoDB Mongoose SQL Databases PostgreSQL / MySQL Database Design & Relationships ORM/ODM concepts Backend & Development Tools: Git & GitHub npm / package management Postman Docker Environment Variables & Configuration Testing & Debugging Clean Code & Design Patterns MVC Architecture Additional Knowledge: Asynchronous JavaScript Promises & Async/Await Event Loop Microservices concepts Deployment & Hosting Cloud basics CI/CD concepts Security Best Practices 🔹 Requirements:Strong practical experience in Backend JavaScript development. Previous experience delivering technical training or mentoring is preferred. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to simplify complex technical concepts. Ability to deliver practical, project-based training. Must be available to work On-Site in Egypt. 📩 How to Apply: Send your updated CV to: rania.nasser@amit-learning.com Please mention “Backend JavaScript Instructor” in the email subject. Join AMIT Learning and help shape the next generation of developers! 🚀 ⁩ ⁩
